top_signals.title: Faltering Philippine Growth Spurs Calls for State Action, Pause in Rate Hikes
top_signals.summary: A surprise slowdown in the Philippine economy has triggered calls for the central bank to go easy on interest rate increases, and for President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to do more to revive growth.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Rare Earth Price Gap Flags Supply Strains Ahead of Trump-Xi Meet
top_signals.summary: A global rush to secure strategic metals is taking on new urgency ahead of a possible meeting of the US and Chinese leaders this month, with rare-earth elements now trading outside China at enormous multiples of their domestic value.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
